system.description:
Survival-honed stealth from Tariel's harshest tribal terrain.

  • Waste-Born Stillness: Advantage on Hide checks in wilderness or natural terrain. In natural terrain, your Sneak Attack range is 60ft instead of 30ft.
  • Ghost of the Sands: Advantage on checks evading tracking in harsh terrain.
